reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the internal geometry of the current candidate partition. All eight sets show a dominant leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), with secondary gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set. Within-set consensus affinity varies across sets (highest for K8_C0007 and K8_C0001, lowest for K8_C0005 and K8_C0002), describing internal cohesion of current membership. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly low relative to within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries at K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0006–K8_C0008, and K8_C0002–K8_C0003. This is partition-scope structural evidence only; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and the absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior reports or additional modality-specific native-geometry results are available in this round; the structural screen is the sole evidence source. The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, so these results are not external validation or a stability score.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase, slice thickness, z spacing, manufacturer, study year, pixel spacing, and tissue source site (all q<0.05), with scanner model and reconstruction kernel borderline or non-significant after adjustment. CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site also show dispersion differences (or, for site, no dispersion difference), so PERMANOVA for phase and manufacturer may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and must not be read as candidate-specific confounding; a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact, and non-significance does not establish absence of confounding.
reports.cross_evidence_context: This partition-scope confounder evidence is complementary to the set-scope transcriptomic phenotypes and the pair-scope geometry concordance reports; it describes a partition-wide technical concern rather than any candidate-specific alternative explanation.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.
A significant PERMANOVA does not establish technical artifact or causation.
Nonsignificant PERMANOVA/PERMDISP does not establish absence of confounding.
PERMDISP was not estimable for reconstruction kernel and scanner model because some levels have fewer than two observations.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and are not directly comparable.
Factor R-squared values are univariable and must not be added or interpreted as independent causal variance explained.
No covariate adjustment or causal control is supported by this analysis.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the internal geometry of the current candidate partition. All eight sets show a dominant leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), with secondary gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set. Within-set consensus affinity varies across sets (highest for K8_C0007 and K8_C0001, lowest for K8_C0005 and K8_C0002), describing internal cohesion of current membership. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly low relative to within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries at K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0006–K8_C0008, and K8_C0002–K8_C0003. This is partition-scope structural evidence only; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and the absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
screen_candidate_k=1 indicates absence of a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, not evidence of independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
No native-modality (CT, WSI, RNA, WXS) patient-geometry results are present in this round, so cross-modal coherence cannot be assessed.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase, slice thickness, z spacing, manufacturer, study year, pixel spacing, and tissue source site (all q<0.05), with scanner model and reconstruction kernel borderline or non-significant after adjustment. CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site also show dispersion differences (or, for site, no dispersion difference), so PERMANOVA for phase and manufacturer may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and must not be read as candidate-specific confounding; a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact, and non-significance does not establish absence of confounding.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the internal geometry of the current candidate partition. All eight sets show a dominant leading eigengap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), with secondary gaps far smaller, so the screening calculation does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal in any set. Within-set consensus affinity varies across sets (highest for K8_C0007 and K8_C0001, lowest for K8_C0005 and K8_C0002), describing internal cohesion of current membership. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly low relative to within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries at K8_C0004–K8_C0006, K8_C0006–K8_C0008, and K8_C0002–K8_C0003. This is partition-scope structural evidence only; it does not establish biological meaning or clinical validity, and the absence of a subdivision signal is neither positive nor negative evidence about independence from neighboring candidates.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.
screen_candidate_k=1 indicates absence of a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, not evidence of independence from neighboring candidates.
Nearest-pair affinities are a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
No native-modality (CT, WSI, RNA, WXS) patient-geometry results are present in this round, so cross-modal coherence cannot be assessed.
Structural or cross-modal evidence does not by itself establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

This characterizes biological identity only; it does not establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At partition scope, multiple measured technical, acquisition, and site factors show statistically significant associations with the partition geometry: CT phase, slice thickness, z spacing, manufacturer, study year, pixel spacing, and tissue source site (all q<0.05), with scanner model and reconstruction kernel borderline or non-significant after adjustment. CT phase, manufacturer, and tissue source site also show dispersion differences (or, for site, no dispersion difference), so PERMANOVA for phase and manufacturer may reflect both location and dispersion. These are partition-wide associations and must not be read as candidate-specific confounding; a significant PERMANOVA is not proof of technical artifact, and non-significance does not establish absence of confounding.
limitations: Partition-scope association describes a partition-wide technical concern and must not be presented as a candidate-specific confounder association.
A significant PERMANOVA does not establish technical artifact or causation.
Nonsignificant PERMANOVA/PERMDISP does not establish absence of confounding.
PERMDISP was not estimable for reconstruction kernel and scanner model because some levels have fewer than two observations.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and are not directly comparable.
Factor R-squared values are univariable and must not be added or interpreted as independent causal variance explained.
No covariate adjustment or causal control is supported by this analysis.

reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the current candidate partition in the candidate-generation consensus geometry. All seven candidate sets show their dominant spectral gap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), so the internal screen does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any set; this is absence of a subdivision signal, not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates. Within-set consensus affinity is highest for K8_C0007 (0.685) and K8_C0001 (0.635) and lowest for K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 (0.301), with the other sets near 0.38-0.40. Nearest-pair between-set affinities identify K8_C0002-K8_C0003 (0.173) and K8_C0004-K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 (0.156) as the relatively closest boundaries, followed by K8_C0001-K8_C0004 (0.121) and K8_C0002-K8_C0004 (0.118); these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions. No feasible k>=2 internal subdivision solutions or native-view separation measurements were produced, so set-level subdivision cannot be assessed from this screen. Overall, the partition-level pattern is limited structural triage evidence: it describes internal cohesion and nearest boundaries in the consensus geometry but does not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept, drop, split, or merge action.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence on the current candidate partition in the candidate-generation consensus geometry. All seven candidate sets show their dominant spectral gap at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), so the internal screen does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any set; this is absence of a subdivision signal, not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates. Within-set consensus affinity is highest for K8_C0007 (0.685) and K8_C0001 (0.635) and lowest for K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 (0.301), with the other sets near 0.38-0.40. Nearest-pair between-set affinities identify K8_C0002-K8_C0003 (0.173) and K8_C0004-K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 (0.156) as the relatively closest boundaries, followed by K8_C0001-K8_C0004 (0.121) and K8_C0002-K8_C0004 (0.118); these are pair-review entry points rather than merge conclusions. No feasible k>=2 internal subdivision solutions or native-view separation measurements were produced, so set-level subdivision cannot be assessed from this screen. Overall, the partition-level pattern is limited structural triage evidence: it describes internal cohesion and nearest boundaries in the consensus geometry but does not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept, drop, split, or merge action.
limitations: Structural diagnostics are partition-level triage evidence and do not by themselves establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
The geometry basis is candidate-generation consensus, not external validation or a stability score.

Nearest-pair affinities are pair-review entry points, not merge conclusions, and do not establish full-partition membership.

This is a recognizable ccRCC-associated chromatin/VHL program relative to the rest of the partition. Other driver-panel genes are either non-estimable (CDKN2A) or not robust after correction.

plan.rationale: Router authorized a provisional merge of K8_C0006 and K8_C0008 based on the weak/conflicting boundary and single-cluster-dominated union. Structural diagnostics for the pair show moderate independent two-way spectral agreement (ARI 0.506), within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity (0.442 vs 0.178), moderate-to-high normalized-cut cost (0.635), and a union eigengap dominated by candidate_k=1, which is merge-compatible. This plan executes the authorized structural operation only and does not constitute acceptance or final subtype assignment.

Structural diagnostics for the pair show low independent two-way spectral agreement (ARI 0.354), within-side affinity barely exceeding between-side affinity (0.337 vs 0.156), high normalized-cut cost (0.656), and a union eigengap dominated by candidate_k=1, which is merge-compatible. This plan executes the authorized structural operation only and does not constitute acceptance or final subtype assignment.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates internal subdivision and nearest-pair boundary affinity in the candidate-generation consensus geometry. Every set shows its dominant spectral gap at k=1, so the screen does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate; the leading gaps and within-set affinities are largest for K8_C0001 and K8_C0007 and smallest for the merged set K8_C0004_M_K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008. Between-set affinities are uniformly lower than within-set affinities, with K8_C0002–K8_C0003 the relatively closest pair. These observations describe the current partition's internal structure and boundary geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept, drop, split, or merge action.

Up-regulated programs (EMT, MYC targets) are present but do not survive the same multiplicity stringency (q>0.1). The pattern is directionally consistent across several related metabolic pathways, indicating an interpretable biological phenotype rather than isolated pathway noise.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: This partition-level structural screen evaluates internal subdivision and nearest-pair boundary affinity in the candidate-generation consensus geometry. Every set shows its dominant spectral gap at k=1, so the screen does not reveal a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal for any candidate; the leading gaps and within-set affinities are largest for K8_C0001 and K8_C0007 and smallest for the merged set K8_C0004_M_K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008. Between-set affinities are uniformly lower than within-set affinities, with K8_C0002–K8_C0003 the relatively closest pair. These observations describe the current partition's internal structure and boundary geometry; they do not establish biological meaning, clinical validity, or any accept, drop, split, or merge action.
limitations: Partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence only and do not independently establish retention, split, or merge.

reports.dimension_interpretation: Partition-level structural diagnostics provide triage evidence about the current candidate partition. The internal screen shows the dominant spectral gap at k=1 for every set, so no candidate set exhibits a screening-level internal subdivision signal; this is absence of a subdivision signal, not evidence about independence from neighboring candidates. Within-set consensus affinity is heterogeneous, with K8_C0007 and K8_C0001 strongest and K8_C0004_M_K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 and K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003 weakest. Nearest-pair between-set affinities are uniformly lower than the corresponding within-set affinities, with the closest boundaries being K8_C0001-K8_C0004_M_K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 and K8_C0002_M_K8_C0003-K8_C0005. These observations describe internal structure and boundary proximity in the candidate-generation consensus geometry; they do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity and do not prescribe retention, split, or merge.

plan.rationale: Router authorized a provisional merge of K8_C0002 and K8_C0003 based on the weakest boundary in the partition. Structural diagnostics for the pair show the highest between-side affinity (0.173) and highest normalized-cut cost (0.634) among examined pairs, with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.530), which is merge-compatible. Native-view boundary geometry is only weakly positive across all four modalities, and set-level membership representation is negative or near-null for both sets, so neither set is independently represented against this neighbor. This plan executes the authorized structural operation only and does not constitute acceptance or final subtype assignment.

Router authorized a provisional merge of K8_C0006 and K8_C0008 based on the weak/conflicting boundary and single-cluster-dominated union. Structural diagnostics for the pair show moderate independent two-way spectral agreement (ARI 0.506), within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity (0.442 vs 0.178), moderate-to-high normalized-cut cost (0.635), and a union eigengap dominated by candidate_k=1, which is merge-compatible. This plan executes the authorized structural operation only and does not constitute acceptance or final subtype assignment.

Router authorized a provisional merge of K8_C0004 and K8_C0006_M_K8_C0008 based on the weakly represented boundary and single-cluster-dominated union. Structural diagnostics for the pair show low independent two-way spectral agreement (ARI 0.354), within-side affinity barely exceeding between-side affinity (0.337 vs 0.156), high normalized-cut cost (0.656), and a union eigengap dominated by candidate_k=1, which is merge-compatible. This plan executes the authorized structural operation only and does not constitute acceptance or final subtype assignment.

The pattern is directionally coherent and interpretable as a distinct metabolic identity, though the target set is small (n=13) against a large heterogeneous rest (n=90).
